decisions.notes: CWE-23 present links filebuf::close to filebuf::open and omits the externally influenced path construction that establishes traversal exposure.
CWE-400 present links acceptSocket = -1 to recv and does not expose the unbounded count or repeated resource-consuming operation.
CWE-401 present links a non-null guard to malloc but omits the allocation path without a corresponding release that is required for the leak relation.
CWE-457 present links one printed struct member to another and supplies no initialization/write evidence for the member read at the sink.
CWE-590 present links a non-null guard to delete but omits the pointer origin proving that the deallocated address is not a valid heap base.
CWE-606 present links strlen(dataBuffer) to fgets and omits the externally controlled loop bound and repeated operation that establish unchecked iteration.
